title: Historical Archives
intro: Spain's libraries and archives hold vast collections of scanned historical documents that are searchable by metadata, but not by what they actually say. We apply OCR to extract the full text and make these collections explorable by content. The examples below show pages from across the output — each region is detected automatically, and the extracted text appears beside it.
